text: {"reasoning":"To verify independently, I query the refund figures for the EU across both months rather than a single month, and break them out by refund reason so the driver of any increase is visible rather than asserted. I include Commerce.orderCount as the record-count measure so each reason/month cell carries its sample size, plus refundRate to see whether the rise is volume-driven or a genuine rate shift. Monthly granularity on orderedAt over 2026-06-01 to 2026-07-31 with a region = EU filter reconstructs the comparison from the question's own terms without reusing the analyst's query shape.","query":{"measures":["Commerce.refundAmount","Commerce.refundRate","Commerce.orderCount","Commerce.grossRevenue"],"dimensions":["Commerce.refundReason"],"time_dimensions":[{"dimension":"Commerce.orderedAt","granularity":"month","date_range":["2026-06-01","2026-07-31"]}],"filters":[{"member":"Commerce.region","operator":"equals","values":["EU"]}]}}
